text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: node/storage pressure detected in gpu-pool-us-east-2. Multiple pods reporting OOMKilled + Evicted (ephemeral-storage). Auto-runbook: /incidents/storage-evict-playbook triggered.

devon: seeing a spike in eviction events for model-serve-* on node gpu-101. Kube events show `Evicted` reason: "nodefsPressure" and containers are OOMKilled on restart. Logs show repeated model cache build spikes.

tara-oncall: I'm taking this. tagging @luca-sre for GPU/CUDA angle. Any customer-facing impact?

luca-sre: nvidia-smi shows processes being killed after container restart. Kernel logs on node show `Out of memory: Kill process` followed by `oom_reaper` on modelcache worker. Likely combined memory + ephemeral writeback.

devon: stack: modelcache writes temp shard files to /scratch/modelcache/<model>/shard-*.tmp while compaction runs. Disk IO and journal grew, filled local-ssd (40GB). The serving runtime then crashes on next allocation -> CUDA init fails with `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` during allocator init.

tara-oncall: customer impact: A few low-latency endpoints returned 5xx or timed out. Metrics: 2.8% error increase for hosted route `redwood-text-gen-prod` over last 10m. Not widespread yet.

ops-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-INC-3891. Incident lead: tara-oncall.

luca-sre: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon gpu-101, 2) drain non-critical model pods (model-cache compaction triggers), 3) reduce modelcache shard parallelism via env var MODELCACHE_PARALLELISM=1 and set TMPDIR=/var/tmp (smaller write), 4) restart kubelet with --eviction-hard adjusted? (we'll avoid node reboot if possible).

devon: commands I'm running now:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-101
kubectl get pods -o wide | grep gpu-101
kubectl delete pod model-serve-qa-7f9d -n prod --grace-period=30
```
I also opened `kubectl describe node gpu-101` shows ephemeral-storage pressure at 98%.

luca-sre: watching `dmesg` and `journalctl -k` while we drain. I see repeated `writeback` stalls and `ext4_fsync` slow path. Suspect ext4 journal paired with heavy ephemeral writes.

tara-oncall: I've posted a short customer note to status: "We are investigating increased errors for text-generation endpoints in us-east-2. Mitigation in progress. No data loss expected." (reaction :eyes:).

eng-ml-anya: adding: recent model rollout increased shard compaction frequency (cron job) — could be correlated. Will flip rollout to previous revision on Dedicated targets if needed.

devon: drained ~6 pods from the node. Freed ~12GB. Starting one pod back with reduced MODELCACHE_PARALLELISM.

luca-sre: after restart of one worker with MODELCACHE_PARALLELISM=1, the runtime initializes cleanly and GPU processes persist. No CUDA errors so far. Monitoring.

tara-oncall: telemetry: error rate trending down from +2.8% to +0.6% over 12m. Latency p50 stable. Marking immediate mitigation as successful for now.

devon: follow-ups we should capture: - Add ephemeral-storage alert with earlier threshold (75% not 90%) - Add a pre-eviction hook to reduce parallel compaction when disk > 70% - Harden modelcache to write smaller temp files (streamed writes) - Add node-level io saturation alerting (iowait and ext4 writeback metrics).

luca-sre: also recommend setting kube eviction thresholds on these GPU nodes to be more conservative and align kubelet.evictionHard for ephemeral-storage with our expected compaction workload.

tara-oncall: logging an incident ticket with timeline + commands: INCIDENT-3891 in ops. I'll schedule a postmortem tomorrow. Please append any logs/commands you ran.

devon: pasted important snippets to the ticket (kubectl describe, dmesg outputs), and attached `kubectl logs` of the crashed container showing `RuntimeError: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY during allocator init` and `ModelCache: failed to rename shard-123.tmp -> shard-123` errors.

eng-ml-anya: rollback of the compaction cron flagged as a canary for next 24h. Will also add a config flag to throttle compaction under disk pressure.

ops-bot: Incident PD-INC-3891 updated: status -> mitigating. Next update in 30m or on any change.

tara-oncall: thanks team. I'll keep thread open for the postmortem. If anyone sees residual OOMs or CUDA init failures after 30m, @tara-oncall please ping. (reaction :thumbsup:).
